title: Verify artifact integrity under hostile and late-failure conditions

context.use: Read the entire linked section; normative details override this task summary.
Read the entire linked section; normative details override this task summary.

outcome: An independent verifier demonstrates immutable and contained artifact behavior for both task kinds.

artifacts.purpose: Required fixed multi-label replay-tolerance and resolved inspection-source corrections
Input/result/evidence tampering matrix and exact source-origin proof
Race, relocation, privacy, inspection-source schema and exit tests

interfaces: Use isolated local fixtures; mutate only owned test runs.
Test missing/extra/duplicate/swapped evidence bindings, original strings/ordinal paths, changed bytes and escaping symlinks.
Replay checks metadata and recomputed outputs, with exact structural/count/status comparisons and declared floating tolerance.
acceptance_criteria: No original-path lookup during replay; same-basename/parent-relative source cases relocate successfully.
Existing file/directory/symlink destinations cannot be replaced, including concurrent creation; late failure leaves no final result.
Routine stdout/stderr/error/report does not expose input/evidence sentinels; inspection returns exact selected payload and integer.
Exit classifications cover actual filesystem, validation, and replay inconsistency failures.

verification.expected: Every defined corruption produces typed failure, no successful comparison.
Both task kinds preserve no-overwrite, relocation, privacy and exits.
Two source definitions and correct row references; `mixed_source`, source counts of one each, and both origins available in inspection/comparison.
Invalid row reference rejected; comparison exposes definition changes despite equal source-ID strings.
Different digest; existing runs unchanged; incompatible comparison rejected.
Default rejection; explicit paired recomputation with exclusions disclosed.
Hard metrics `no_data` on both sides. Probability statuses respectively `no_data`/`no_data`, `not_applicable`/`not_applicable`, and `no_data`/`not_applicable`; null deltas.
Both ID lists preserved even if headline accuracy is unchanged.
No overwrite or finalized partial result; correct exit category.
Inspection/comparison succeeds from copied evidence alone after original sources become unavailable.
Integrity failure with no lookup of the original evidence path.
`result_path` names the actual result file; independent SHA-256 of its bytes equals `result_sha256`.
No payload in reports/errors; inspection returns the stored selected input as JSON.
Inspection preserves that numeric value; no conversion to rounded binary64.
`neither_correct` plus changed-outcome ID and per-label transition evidence; partial changes are not hidden by exact-match categories.
Same selected population, explicit answered populations/overlap; conditional metric changes are not described as paired model improvement.
Signal applicability retained; present marginals yield `no_data`, absent marginals `not_applicable`.
Strict canonical validation passes; original, prepared, and working values remain distinct and reproducible. No claim that normalization establishes calibration.

verification_responsibility: A different agent from the implementation author reruns evidence and reviews every acceptance criterion; integrator accepts only the saved response.
common_completion_checks: All listed artifacts contain implemented behavior or required evidence; no placeholders.

All tests assigned to this task are listed by Cargo and execute with a nonzero expected test count. Compound conformance/structure cases have explicit later audit test owners in coverage.json; implementers still test each local invariant now.
Relevant fmt/Clippy/test/build checks pass on the pinned toolchain; no bypass, changed tolerance or weakened oracle.
Saved response records exact input/source/output hashes, commands, exit codes, expected/actual results, and unresolved failures.
New or changed-authority artifacts are indexed; operational state is updated in Fizzy after acceptance.
